formatting more than 1,048,576 cells at: One format over more than a full column's cells, short of whole rows or columns. Whole rows and columns go another way. The gap is reported and nothing is changed.
editing a filtered sheet whose rows are: A sheet whose rows are hidden by default and which also has a filter. A macro has no plain way to make one, though a loaded file can carry it. The macro gets the report and no wrong answer.
